predecessors.name: Turkestan ASSR
predecessors.text: the Transcaspian Oblast: Ashgabat, Krasnovodsk and Merv

predecessors.name: Bukharan People's Soviet Republic
predecessors.text: Chardzhou (Charjew) and Kerki on the Amu Darya, from Bukhara

ledger.x: 1924, October: the Politburo divided the territories "In October 1924" and the lands "were unified to create the Turkmen Soviet Socialist Republic"; the core is the Transcaspian Oblast of the Turkestan ASSR.
1924, October: Charjew, Kerki and part of Shirabad join from the Bukharan People's Republic.
1924, October: "the Turkmen (Dasoguz) province of Khorezm People's Republic" joins.
1925, 13 May: a separate republic of the USSR "as the Turkmen SSR".
1991, 27 October: "it became independent as Turkmenistan" (sovereignty declared 22 August 1990; recognised 26 December 1991).

certainty.note: "The borders of Soviet Turkmenistan remained unchanged."
